summary: NorthStrive Acquisition Corp I., a Cayman-incorporated blank-check company trading on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K announcing that commencing September 2, 2026, holders of its IPO units may elect to separately trade the Class A ordinary shares, Rights and redeemable warrants bundled in each unit. Units not separated continue trading as NSAIU; separated shares, rights and warrants trade as NSAI, NSAIR and NSAIW. No fractional rights or warrants will trade. Separation requires broker contact with transfer agent VStock Transfer. This is an ordinary SPAC unit-split notice, not a business combination, with no deal terms; watch for an initial business combination announcement and any extension or redemption dynamics.
